$schema: clone-website extraction artifact — consumed by scripts/emit-design-system.ts
name: Bridge & Human

extraction.method: Rendered Framer DOM, computed-style extraction, asset inventory, and 1440px / 768px / 390px Playwright captures.
extraction.note: Editorial monochrome design-strategy portfolio with generous white space, geometric media frames, restrained mono metadata, and display typography.

--bg.reason: Continuous page canvas and the sampled Framer About surface are white.

--surface.reason: Header and card-like content regions retain the white base surface.

--surface-warm.reason: Warm near-white supports quiet media and fixture surfaces without adding a competing palette.
--surface-warm.source: derived from observed white/black monochrome system

--fg.reason: Computed primary text, logo stroke, progress line, and primary button background are rgb(17, 17, 17).
--fg.source: computed visible desktop text and Framer token --token-843f…

--fg-2.reason: Display headings use the same observed black foreground.

--muted.reason: Reserved subdued textual tier for explanatory content.

--meta.reason: Mobile Scroll control and small instructional text render as a quiet black with reduced opacity.

--border.reason: Observed compact metadata chip and translucent media-action outlines use a thin black border.

--border-soft.reason: Low-emphasis divider continuation behind the desktop progress marker.

--accent.reason: The brand is deliberately monochrome; the action color is the same near-black as primary foreground.

--accent-on.reason: Computed primary button copy is white.

--accent-hover.reason: Slightly lighter black preserves a usable hover response without changing brand character.
--accent-hover.source: derived because Framer hover is a masked liquid layer rather than a flat color

--success.reason: No success role occurs in the extracted page.

--warn.reason: No warning role occurs in the extracted page.

--danger.reason: No danger role occurs in the extracted page.

--font-display.reason: Computed desktop display heading uses Geist.
--font-display.source: computed 1440px Design That / Connects. paragraphs and Google Fonts @font-face

--font-body.value: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Placeholder", sans-serif
--font-body.reason: Computed labels, body copy, controls, and logo name use IBM Plex Sans.

--font-mono.reason: Date, copyright, chip, and microcopy use IBM Plex Mono.

--text-xs.reason: Mobile chips, delivery labels, and project links are 10px.

--text-sm.reason: Desktop date, body description, and copyright labels are 12px.

--text-lg.reason: Desktop eyebrow and action labels are 18px.
--text-lg.source: computed 1440px We Craft and primary action

--text-xl.reason: Desktop header arrows use 28px IBM Plex Sans Light.

--text-3xl.reason: Intermediate display tier between mobile statement and 88px desktop hero.

--text-4xl.source: computed 1440px Design That and Connects. text

--leading-body.reason: IBM Plex body values compute to 14.4px at 12px and 21.6px at 18px.

--leading-tight.reason: Desktop display copies use 87.8265px font-size and line-height.

--tracking-display.reason: Desktop display tracking computes to -2.61792px on an 87.8265px font.

--space-1.reason: Smallest spacing increment used for fine icon and label adjustment.

--space-4.reason: Secondary layout interval consistent with mobile control stack.

--space-5.reason: Desktop primary action uses 24px vertical padding.
--space-5.source: computed Start A Conversation anchor padding

--section-y-desktop.reason: Desktop header and progress band occupy 60px before the media story.

--section-y-tablet.reason: Tablet retains the mobile header band height.

--section-y-phone.reason: Mobile hero media starts immediately below the 60px header.

--radius-md.reason: Primary actions and chips use 30px radius.

--radius-lg.reason: Desktop hero media uses a visibly large rounded frame.

--radius-pill.reason: Pill actions and small metadata chip are fully rounded.

--elev-flat.reason: The target uses border and contrast rather than shadows.

--elev-ring.reason: Soft inner ring approximates observed glass-like media actions over imagery.

--elev-raised.reason: Subtle accessibility-safe elevation for overlays; not used by the dominant flat layout.

--focus-ring.reason: Visible keyboard treatment that preserves monochrome direction.
--focus-ring.source: derived for accessibility; target Framer page has no visible ring

--motion-base.reason: Carousel change is perceptibly slower than micro-controls.

--ease-standard.reason: Close visual stand-in for the source Framer spring transition.

--container-max.reason: Desktop shell spans viewport less two 12px outer insets.
